title: Proper-support direct image preserves bounded coherent complexes
statement: Let S be a Noetherian scheme [def-pc-scheme] and f:X\to S a morphism locally of finite type. If E is bounded with coherent cohomology on X [def-pc-derived-category] and every cohomology sheaf of E has support proper over S [def-weil-pbc-closed-subset-proper-over-base], then Rf_*E [def-pc-derived-direct-image] has bounded coherent cohomology on S.

source.place: Derived Categories of Schemes, Lemma 36.11.3 (Tag 08E2; label lemma-direct-image-coherent)

proof.text: Represent E by a strictly bounded-below complex K of $\mathcal O_X$-modules and apply [thm-sp-truncation-e2] with $v=f_*:\mathrm{Mod}(\mathcal O_X)\to\mathrm{Mod}(\mathcal O_S)$, a left exact additive functor between Grothendieck abelian categories (Stacks 077K), so that $Rv(K)=Rf_*E$. It gives the convergent spectral sequence $E_2^{p,q}=R^pf_*H^q(E)\Rightarrow H^{p+q}(Rf_*E)$, with $E_2^{p,q}=0$ unless $p\ge0$ and $q\ge a$ (where $H^q(E)=0$ for $q<a$), and finite filtrations on the abutment cohomology sheaves whose graded pieces are the $E_\infty^{p,q}$ (parts 2, 3, 5 and 6 of [thm-sp-truncation-e2]).

source.place: Derived Categories of Schemes, Lemma 36.11.3 (Tag 08E2), proof

proof.text: For every q, H^q(E) is coherent and its support is proper over S by the hypotheses. Therefore [lem-pc-coherent-support-proper-higher-direct-image] makes every E_2^{p,q}=R^p f_*H^q(E) coherent.

source.place: Derived Categories of Schemes, Lemma 36.11.3 (Tag 08E2), proof

proof.text: The coherent-kernel/cokernel theorem propagates coherence from E2 to each derived page. For each total degree, the canonical finite-page comparison identifies the graded pieces of the abutment filtration with finite pages. Descend through its finite chain of subobjects: the final step is zero and each preceding step is an extension of its successor by a coherent graded piece. This elementary induction is proved locally as property_of_filtration for an arbitrary antitone subobject family; no quasi-coherent direct-image theorem is used.

source.place: Derived Categories of Schemes, Lemma 36.11.3 (Tag 08E2), proof

proof.text: The bounded-below assertion is immediate from part 3 of [thm-sp-truncation-e2] used in Step 1: if $H^q(E)=0$ for $q<a$, every term of total degree $n<a$ vanishes, so $H^n(Rf_*E)=0$ for $n<a$.

source.place: Derived Categories of Schemes, Lemma 36.11.3 (Tag 08E2), proof: 'Boundedness from below is trivial'

proof.text: Transport coherence and proper support to the bounded-below representative through the homology isomorphism; proper support is invariant because its nonzero-stalk locus is invariant. Choose N(q) from [lem-pc-proper-support-module-higher-direct-image-bound]. Let c be the finite supremum of N(q)+q.toNat for q in [a,b], with value zero for the empty interval. If p+q>c, E2 is zero: p<0 by the quadrant bound; q outside [a,b] because the coefficient is zero; otherwise the supremum inequality forces p.toNat>=N(q). At any such bidegree induct over derived couples: each next page is an epimorphic quotient of a kernel subobject of the preceding zero term, hence zero. The finite-page comparison kills every graded piece of the abutment filtration. Apply the same locally proved finite filtration induction to the zero-object property, using exactness with zero outer terms, to kill the abutment. Combine this upper bound with the lower bound and coherence.
